issues: In ExportScreen (expo-app/src/screens/ExportScreen.tsx), the export buttons use React Native's built‑in <Button> component. The UI flow test cannot locate or click the "Export CSV" button, causing a failure in the primary flow check. Replace the native <Button> with the custom PrimaryButton component (imported from '../components/PrimaryButton'), update the imports accordingly, and adjust props (use title, onPress, disabled, loading) to match PrimaryButton's API. This will make the buttons discoverable by the accessibility tests and resolve the UI flow failure.
feedback: The core backend functionality passes all unit tests, but the UI primary flow test fails because the Export screen's button is not compatible with the testing framework's locators. Updating ExportScreen to use the existing PrimaryButton component will align the UI with the design spec and allow the test to click the Export CSV button successfully.
